title: Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims: Annual Aggregate Limit of the Tiers
content:
The CargoCare tiers of `Cargo Liability, CargoCare and Cargo Claims` place a ceiling, the annual aggregate, on the settlements that may be approved; the two liability tiers below them set none.

## Aggregate figures

| Tier | Annual aggregate limit (USD) |
|---|---|
| `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` | 0.00 |
| `AHL Declared Value Liability` | 0.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Essential` | 150000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Plus` | 300000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Premium` | 750000.00 |
| `AHL CargoCare Total` | 2000000.00 |

An aggregate figure of 0.00 means that the tier has no aggregate at all. Settlements under `AHL Standard Carrier Liability` and under `AHL Declared Value Liability` are accordingly never subject to an aggregate.

## Clauses in force

- **Exhausted aggregate.** Where nothing of the aggregate remains, the claim is nonetheless granted approval for a settlement of 0.00, the aggregate limit being named as the measure that fixed the sum. It is not rejected: the loss itself is covered, and it is only the aggregate that has been used up.

## Retired clauses

- The earlier provision that CargoCare tiers keep one annual aggregate for each cover holder is **no longer in force**.
- The earlier provision that added up, over a trailing period of 365 days, the settlements approved on every cover of the tier held by the same holder, and required that total together with the settlement under approval to stay within the tier's limit, is likewise **no longer in force**.

The aggregate figures in the table above remain valid; what has been withdrawn is only the earlier way of measuring the room left under them.

## Basis Q&A

- *Can an approval under `AHL CargoCare Plus` be turned into a rejection because the aggregate has run out?* No. The claim is approved at 0.00, with the aggregate limit as the recorded measure.
- *Does a claim under `AHL Declared Value Liability` ever meet an aggregate?* No. That tier's figure is 0.00, which means no aggregate.

superseded_clauses: CargoCare products carry an annual aggregate per cover holder.

For a product whose annual_aggregate_limit_usd is above 0.00, the settlements approved on all the cover holder's covers of that product in the trailing 365 days, claims_msr_settled_365d, plus the settlement being approved may not exceed the product's annual_aggregate_limit_usd.
